settings.token.label: API token
settings.token.description: Stored as plain text in Noctalia's settings. Prefer a token file or the TODOIST_API_TOKEN environment variable.
settings.token_file.label: Token file
settings.token_file.description: Path to a file holding your Todoist API token. Either the bare token or a line like TODOIST_API_TOKEN = xxx works.
settings.default_project.label: Default project
settings.default_project.description: Shown as a capture hint. Todoist parses #project from the task text.
settings.default_labels.label: Default labels
settings.default_labels.description: Shown as a capture hint. Todoist parses projects and labels from the task text.
settings.default_priority.label: Default priority
settings.default_priority.description: Shown as a capture hint. Todoist parses p1-p4 from the task text.
settings.cache_tasks.label: Keep tasks locally
settings.cache_tasks.description: Stores the last loaded tasks in plain text on this computer so the panel can paint before the first request.
settings.max_retries.label: Automatic retries
settings.max_retries.description: How many times a failed read is retried. Creating a task is never retried.
settings.confirm_delete.label: Confirm before deleting
settings.confirm_delete.description: Ask for confirmation in the panel before a task is deleted.
